## What problem does this solve?
Describe the concrete audit workflow or verification problem, not only the proposed solution.

## Proposed change
What you would like `sec-audit` to enforce or expose (keeping 1:1 parity between CLI subcommands and MCP tools).

## Alternatives considered
Other approaches you evaluated and why this one is preferable.

## Notes
- `sec-audit` uses the Go standard library only (zero external dependencies) and enforces deterministic, source-grounded verification.
